name: St Helena Government Main Data Centre, Carnarvon Court
notes: Official St Helena Government release and Gazette exemption identify SHG's Main Data Centre at Carnarvon Court in Jamestown as an existing essential-services site receiving Schneider Electric critical backup battery commissioning in March 2022. Capacity not published. A 2020 official electronic-communications EOI also listed on-island Teleport & Data Centre services, but a later procurement update said no agreement was reached; no separate hyperscale/colo project was confirmed.
